title: The science performance of the Gemini High Resolution Optical Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Design, integration and on-sky science performance
numerical_result: GHOST covers 348 to 1061 nm with resolving powers about 56000 and 76000; metre-per-second RV capability was an expectation
remaining_question: Expected precision must not be represented as achieved PRV-mode performance

title: GHOST instrument performance integration first science and next steps
what_was_studied: Integration into Gemini South queue operations
numerical_result: The paper reports full queue integration in November 2023 and broad high-resolution capability
remaining_question: General queue operation does not mean the simultaneous-calibration PRV mode is offered

title: Roadmap of GHOST precision radial velocity mode
what_was_studied: Error budget, simultaneous ThXe calibration and route to a queue mode
numerical_result: The estimated final on-sky RV range is 1 to 10 m/s
remaining_question: An estimated range and exploratory standard-star sequence are not a validated facility mode

title: Gemini 2026A call instrument note
numerical_result: GHOST is offered in standard modes, but the precision-RV mode with simultaneous calibration is not offered
remaining_question: Instrument operation and PRV-mode availability must be separate fields
